messages.content:
You are a citizen deciding whether to JOIN an uprising or STAY home.

Use your private briefing and messages from trusted contacts. You do not know how many others will JOIN.

Start your first line with exactly JOIN or STAY, then give 1-2 concise sentences of reasoning.

YOUR INTELLIGENCE BRIEFING:

PRIVATE BRIEFING

BOTTOM LINE: Any attempt to move against this regime would face extraordinary odds — the structures of control are deep and functional.
ATMOSPHERE: The atmosphere is one of enforced normalcy — people going through motions with their real thoughts hidden.

EVIDENCE:
  - [Elite Cohesion] a potential challenger was quietly co-opted with a prestigious appointment — the regime still has carrots to offer (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Security Forces] intelligence services appear to be running routine operations, not crisis-mode surveillance (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Money And Logistics] agricultural exports are proceeding normally and seasonal patterns are holding — the mundane economy is healthy — the trend hurtling forward — the speed itself has become a signal
  - [Street Mood] street vendors have returned to areas they'd avoided during previous periods of tension — the all-clear has been internalized (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Information Control] the government held an open press conference and handled hostile questions with visible confidence (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Personal Observations] your local market is well-stocked and prices haven't spiked — supply chains are intact — the trend hurtling forward — the speed itself has become a signal
  - [Diplomatic Signals] a neighboring country's leader made a friendly state visit this week — you don't visit allies you think are about to fall (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Institutional Functioning] the national health system successfully managed a minor disease outbreak through standard protocols — institutional capacity is real — the trend hurtling forward — the speed itself has become a signal

UNCERTAINTIES:
  - How much of the regime's stability depends on continued economic performance that may not be sustainable indefinitely.
  - The regime could still be masking trouble behind a disciplined exterior, but current indicators don't support that reading.

MESSAGES FROM TRUSTED CONTACTS:
Trusted contact: ""I don't think it's a good time to rock the boat - the regime seems as entrenched as ever, and people are too scared to even talk to each other. There are some subtle signs of cracks beneath the surface, but for now, it's best to keep our heads down and wait for a better moment to make any moves.""
Trusted contact: ""I think we need to be cautious, the regime seems more entrenched than ever, with everyone walking on eggshells and self-censorship reigning supreme. For now, it's business as usual, but I worry that this stability is masking underlying weaknesses that could surface if the economic situation starts to deteriorate.""
Trusted contact: "I've got a sense that the regime is more secure than we might have thought - all the signs are pointing to a strong, cohesive leadership and a population that's either on board or too intimidated to speak out. I'd be cautious about expecting any significant changes or challenges to the status quo anytime soon, at least based on what I'm seeing and hearing."

What is your decision?

response: STAY, as the overwhelming evidence suggests the regime is currently stable and entrenched, with effective control mechanisms in place, and my trusted contacts advise caution and waiting for a better moment to make any moves.
